실험 일지
실험체: DE5i1
쥐, 토끼, 곰을 순차적으로 실험실에 투입하였다.
투입일은 6월 X일, 7월 X일, 8월 X일이다.
모든 피험 동물에게서 실험체를 발견한 직후 극도의 공포 반응이 관찰되었다.
DE5i1은 피험 동물들을 일정 시간 관찰한 후 공격 행동을 보였다.
공격 이후 동물의 신체는 형체를 식별할 수 없을 정도로 심하게 훼손되었으며, 얼마 지나지 않아 검은색 덩어리 형태로 변이하였다.
해당 검은색 물질은 Fomes로 명명한다.
English(en):
Experiment Log
Test Subject: DE5i1
We attempted to observe the subject using all available imaging equipment, including X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, and cameras, but no discernible internal structure was found.
However, it was confirmed that the subject exhibits behavior similar to that of living organisms, such as reacting to external stimuli.
In particular, it was observed to react sensitively to light and sound.

Experiment Log
Test Subject: DE5i1
Mice, rabbits, and bears were introduced into the laboratory sequentially.
The dates of introduction were June X, July X, and August X.
Immediately after the test subject was discovered, all test animals exhibited extreme fear reactions.
After observing the test animals for a certain period of time, DE5i1 displayed aggressive behavior.
Following the attack, the animals' bodies were so severely mutilated that their forms could no longer be identified, and shortly thereafter, they mutated into black masses.
This black substance is designated as "Fomes."

동일한 현상이 반복적으로 관찰됨에 따라 DE5i1의 분열 현상을 사실로 간주하고 후속 실험을 진행한다.

Researcher A observed and reported that test subject DE5i1 split into two parts and then merged back into a single entity.
Since DE5i1 possesses the characteristic of not being recorded by CCTV, no evidence of the incident was secured. Consequently, researchers took turns monitoring the test subject thereafter.
Subsequently, Researcher B also confirmed that DE5i1 split.

극비 실험 보고서

XX 자극을 가한 후 토끼를 투입하였다. 붉은 실에 접촉한 토끼에게서 이상 반응이 관찰되었다.

두 번째 실험에서는 사형수를 투입한 후 XX 자극을 가하였다. 동일하게 자극을 가한 연구원의 명령에만 반응하는 현상이 관찰되었다.
이상의 결과를 통해 XX 자극에 의해 피험체의 행동을 직접적으로 통제할 수 있는 것으로 판단된다.

XX 자극을 통해 피험체의 정신 및 행동을 통제하는 과정을 Mentem Regere, 약칙 Mentem으로 명명한다.
Mentem에 의해 통제되는 피험체는 Servus로 명명한다.
English(en):
Top-Secret Experiment Report
Test Subject: DE5i1
Mentem Regere Experiment—Follow-up Experiment Following the 13th XX Stimulus-Response Experiment

A rabbit was introduced after the XX stimulus was applied. An abnormal reaction was observed in the rabbit that came into contact with the red thread.
Subsequently, when the researcher who had applied the stimulus issued a command, the rabbit was observed to obey it. It did not respond to commands from other researchers.

In the second experiment, a death row inmate was introduced, and the XX stimulus was applied. Similarly, the subject was observed to respond only to commands from the researcher who administered the stimulus.
Based on these results, it is concluded that the XX stimulus allows for direct control over the subject's behavior.

The process of controlling a subject's mind and behavior through the XX stimulus is named Mentem Regere, abbreviated as Mentem.
A subject controlled by Mentem is designated as a Servus.

Servus는 멘템을 가한 연구원의 명령에만 반응하는 특성을 보이고 있다.
Servus에게 '날아' 라는 명령을 내렸다. Servus는 높은 곳으로 이동한 후 뛰어내렸다.
실행이 불가능한 명령에도 이행하려는 모습을 보인다.
이후 Servus에게 XX이란 명령을 내렸다.
명령 직후 Servus를 중심으로 반경 약 20m 범위에서 공간이 일그러지는 현상이 발생하였다. 잠시 후 해당 범위 내의 환경이 파괴된 것으로 관찰되었다.
외형상 폭발에 의한 파괴와 유사하나, 정확한 발생 과정은 확인하지 못했다. 해당 현상은 카메라에도 정상적으로 기록되지 않았다.

Mentem 및 Servus와 관련된 실험은 극비 사항으로 분류한다. 일부 용어 및 명령은 1급 기밀로 지정하여 열람을 제한한다.
English(en):
Top-Secret Experiment Report
Test Subject: Servus
Servus exhibits the characteristic of responding only to commands given by researchers who have performed a "Mentem" on it.
I gave Servus the command "Fly." Servus moved to a high place and then jumped down.
It appears to attempt to carry out even commands that are impossible to execute.
Subsequently, the command "XX" was issued to Servus.
Immediately after the command, a phenomenon occurred in which space warped within a radius of approximately 20 meters centered on Servus. Shortly thereafter, it was observed that the environment within that radius had been destroyed.
Although the destruction resembled that caused by an explosion, the exact process of the event could not be confirmed. This phenomenon was also not recorded normally by the camera.

Experiments related to Mentem and Servus are classified as top secret. Certain terms and commands are designated as Level 1 classified, and access to them is restricted.
